name: Swooping Hawk

bonuses.name: Swooping Hawk Wings
bonuses.text: This Threat can Fly at Speed 16.

bonuses.name: Skyleap
bonuses.text: Swooping Hawks do not provoke Reflexive Attacks when they move out of Engagement. Swooping Hawks also gain +2 bonus dice when they make a Pinning Attack (Wrath & Glory, page 189).

abilities.name: Sudden Assault
abilities.text: If a Swooping Hawk attacks from above, all opponents must make a DN 3 Initiative Test. If they all fail, the Swooping Hawk may Seize the Initiative without spending Ruin.

abilities.name: Battle Focus
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin immediately before or after making a ranged attack to Move up to the Swooping Hawk's Speed as a Free Action.

options.name: Swooping Hawk Exarch
options.text: A Swooping Hawk Exarch has Weapon Skill 9 and 9 Wounds. They lose their Lasblaster, and gain the equipment and bonuses below: Hawk's Talon: 12 +1 ED / AP -1 / Range 12 - 24 - 36 / Salvo 4 / Assault, Rapid Fire (2); Champion: An Exarch may use Ruin Actions; Suppressing Fire: Swooping Hawks within 10m of their Exarch may spend Shifts on ranged attacks to inflict the Hindered Condition on their target.

note: Speed printed '16 (Fly)'; stored 16 (the Swooping Hawk Wings bonus repeats Fly). No Intense Emotions bonus printed.
